title: Triad Architects
description: triad.co.ke Triad Group is a Kenyan digital marketing and technology company founded in 1993 in Nairobi, making it one of the oldest and largest digital agencies in East Africa with 200 plus employees and 500 plus clients. It operates across five divisions: digital marketing, creative and design, technology, strategy and media, with offices in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda. Its client roster includes major multinational brands like Unilever, Coca-Cola, Safaricom, KCB and Toyota alongside government agencies and NGOs. Services span branding, video production, SEO, social media, software development, AI and machine learning, data analytics and media planning. The company positions itself at the intersection of creativity and technology with a full-service model from strategy to execution. Revenue is estimated in the multi-million dollar range with regional expansion across East Africa.
